name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=spell, descriptor=handler for spell id 2 dispatched via the targeted-blink worker. The trailing '2' is the FD2 spell ID (0x02 = 炎龍術, an offensive spell; spell IDs 00h-23h are stable domain IDs), NOT a Ghidra address residue. It matches both the hardcoded literal pushed (PUSH 0x2) and the dispatch-table slot index: table @ 0x51D01, entry 2 @ +8 = 0x51D09 (= the sole xref to this fn) holds pointer 0x00021364. 'targeted_blink' accurately reflects the worker fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell @ 0x21227, which calls fd2_animate_spell_overlay_blink, and is identical to the sibling family anchor fd2_spell_handler_id_0_via_targeted_blink. Name is consistent with all five family siblings (ids 0/1/2/3/8).
purpose: Spell dispatch thunk for spell id 2 (炎龍術): forwards to the offensive targeted-blink spell worker with the spell_id literal hardcoded to 2.
logic_summary: Thin one-line wrapper. Body (6 inst): PUSH 0x14; CALL __CHK (Watcom stack-probe prologue idiom); re-push num_targets and target_id_array; PUSH 0x2 (spell_id literal); JMP 0x2121A, landing in the shared tail of fd2_spell_handler_id_0_via_targeted_blink (0x21206) which does PUSH caster_unit_id; CALL fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell @ 0x21227; ADD ESP,0x10; RET. Net effect: fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell(caster_unit_id, 2, num_targets, target_id_array). Reached only via spell function-pointer dispatch table @ 0x51D01 (entry index 2 @ 0x51D09); no direct callers.

notes: Thin dispatch thunk; src body is self-documenting (single delegating call) and is covered by the file-level family header comment '=== Targeted blink family (id 0-3, 8) ===' at src/spell/spell.c:24, so no per-function comment block is warranted (comment_verdict=keep). Ghidra plate is detailed and accurate (matches disasm, dispatch table, sibling list) and does not contradict the refined understanding, so plate left untouched (ghidra_plate_action=none). The in_stack_00000000 / __CHK(0x14,...) in the decomp is the Watcom compiler-emitted stack-overflow-probe prologue (PUSH 0x14; CALL __CHK), not a source-level parameter; src correctly omits it and the compiler re-emits it — not a logic concern. No src or plate edits made; only the shard is added in this commit.
